description: This PHP file defines the SaveReportingMethodController class, which handles the preparation of Vue.js components for saving or editing reporting methods within the OrangeHRM application. It determines whether to load an 'edit' or 'save' component based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the Vue component for saving or editing a reporting method, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Checks if an 'id' exists in the request attributes to decide whether to load an edit or save component.
